name: configservice
description: Config Config provides a way to keep track of the configurations of all the Amazon Web Services resources associated with your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: associate-resource-types
subcommands.description: Adds all resource types specified in the ResourceTypes list to the RecordingGroup of specified configuration recorder and includes those resource types when recording.

subcommands.name: batch-get-aggregate-resource-config
subcommands.description: Returns the current configuration items for resources that are present in your Config aggregator.

subcommands.name: batch-get-resource-config
subcommands.description: Returns the BaseConfigurationItem for one or more requested resources.

subcommands.name: delete-aggregation-authorization
subcommands.description: Deletes the authorization granted to the specified configuration aggregator account in a specified region.

subcommands.name: delete-config-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified Config rule and all of its evaluation results.

subcommands.name: delete-configuration-aggregator
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified configuration aggregator and the aggregated data associated with the aggregator.

subcommands.name: delete-configuration-recorder
subcommands.description: Deletes the customer managed configuration recorder.

subcommands.name: delete-conformance-pack
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified conformance pack and all the Config rules, remediation actions, and all evaluation results within that conformance pack.

subcommands.name: delete-connector
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified connector.

subcommands.name: delete-delivery-channel
subcommands.description: Deletes the delivery channel.

subcommands.name: delete-evaluation-results
subcommands.description: Deletes the evaluation results for the specified Config rule.

subcommands.name: delete-organization-config-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified organization Config rule and all of its evaluation results from all member accounts in that organization.

subcommands.name: delete-organization-conformance-pack
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified organization conformance pack and all of the Config rules and remediation actions from all member accounts in that organization.

subcommands.name: delete-pending-aggregation-request
subcommands.description: Deletes pending authorization requests for a specified aggregator account in a specified region.

subcommands.name: delete-remediation-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the remediation configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-remediation-exceptions
subcommands.description: Deletes one or more remediation exceptions mentioned in the resource keys.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-config
subcommands.description: Records the configuration state for a custom resource that has been deleted.

subcommands.name: delete-retention-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the retention configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-service-linked-configuration-recorder
subcommands.description: Deletes an existing service-linked configuration recorder.

subcommands.name: delete-stored-query
subcommands.description: Deletes the stored query for a single Amazon Web Services account and a single Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: deliver-config-snapshot
subcommands.description: Schedules delivery of a configuration snapshot to the Amazon S3 bucket in the specified delivery channel.

subcommands.name: describe-aggregate-compliance-by-config-rules
subcommands.description: Returns a list of compliant and noncompliant rules with the number of resources for compliant and noncompliant rules.

subcommands.name: describe-aggregate-compliance-by-conformance-packs
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the existing and deleted conformance packs and their associated compliance status with the count of compliant and noncompliant Config rules within each conformance pack.

subcommands.name: describe-aggregation-authorizations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of authorizations granted to various aggregator accounts and regions.

subcommands.name: describe-compliance-by-config-rule
subcommands.description: Indicates whether the specified Config rules are compliant.

subcommands.name: describe-compliance-by-resource
subcommands.description: Indicates whether the specified Amazon Web Services resources are compliant.

subcommands.name: describe-config-rule-evaluation-status
subcommands.description: Returns status information for each of your Config managed rules.

subcommands.name: describe-config-rules
subcommands.description: Returns details about your Config rules.

subcommands.name: describe-configuration-aggregator-sources-status
subcommands.description: Returns status information for sources within an aggregator.

subcommands.name: describe-configuration-aggregators
subcommands.description: Returns the details of one or more configuration aggregators.

subcommands.name: describe-configuration-recorder-status
subcommands.description: Returns the current status of the configuration recorder you specify as well as the status of the last recording event for the configuration recorders.

subcommands.name: describe-configuration-recorders
subcommands.description: Returns details for the configuration recorder you specify.

subcommands.name: describe-conformance-pack-compliance
subcommands.description: Returns compliance details for each rule in that conformance pack.

subcommands.name: describe-conformance-pack-status
subcommands.description: Provides one or more conformance packs deployment status.

subcommands.name: describe-conformance-packs
subcommands.description: Returns a list of one or more conformance packs.

subcommands.name: describe-delivery-channel-status
subcommands.description: Returns the current status of the specified delivery channel.

subcommands.name: describe-delivery-channels
subcommands.description: Returns details about the specified delivery channel.

subcommands.name: describe-organization-config-rule-statuses
subcommands.description: Provides organization Config rule deployment status for an organization.

subcommands.name: describe-organization-config-rules
subcommands.description: Returns a list of organization Config rules.

subcommands.name: describe-organization-conformance-pack-statuses
subcommands.description: Provides organization conformance pack deployment status for an organization.

subcommands.name: describe-organization-conformance-packs
subcommands.description: Returns a list of organization conformance packs.

subcommands.name: describe-pending-aggregation-requests
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all pending aggregation requests.

subcommands.name: describe-remediation-configurations
subcommands.description: Returns the details of one or more remediation configurations.

subcommands.name: describe-remediation-exceptions
subcommands.description: Returns the details of one or more remediation exceptions.

subcommands.name: describe-remediation-execution-status
subcommands.description: Provides a detailed view of a Remediation Execution for a set of resources including state, timestamps for when steps for the remediation execution occur, and any error messages for steps that have failed.

subcommands.name: describe-retention-configurations
subcommands.description: Returns the details of one or more retention configurations.

subcommands.name: disassociate-resource-types
subcommands.description: Removes all resource types specified in the ResourceTypes list from the RecordingGroup of configuration recorder and excludes these resource types when recording.

subcommands.name: get-aggregate-compliance-details-by-config-rule
subcommands.description: Returns the evaluation results for the specified Config rule for a specific resource in a rule.

subcommands.name: get-aggregate-config-rule-compliance-summary
subcommands.description: Returns the number of compliant and noncompliant rules for one or more accounts and regions in an aggregator.

subcommands.name: get-aggregate-conformance-pack-compliance-summary
subcommands.description: Returns the count of compliant and noncompliant conformance packs across all Amazon Web Services accounts and Amazon Web Services Regions in an aggregator.

subcommands.name: get-aggregate-discovered-resource-counts
subcommands.description: Returns the resource counts across accounts and regions that are present in your Config aggregator.

subcommands.name: get-aggregate-resource-config
subcommands.description: Returns configuration item that is aggregated for your specific resource in a specific source account and region.

subcommands.name: get-compliance-details-by-config-rule
subcommands.description: Returns the evaluation results for the specified Config rule.

subcommands.name: get-compliance-details-by-resource
subcommands.description: Returns the evaluation results for the specified Amazon Web Services resource.

subcommands.name: get-compliance-summary-by-config-rule
subcommands.description: Returns the number of Config rules that are compliant and noncompliant, up to a maximum of 25 for each.

subcommands.name: get-compliance-summary-by-resource-type
subcommands.description: Returns the number of resources that are compliant and the number that are noncompliant.

subcommands.name: get-conformance-pack-compliance-details
subcommands.description: Returns compliance details of a conformance pack for all Amazon Web Services resources that are monitered by conformance pack.

subcommands.name: get-conformance-pack-compliance-summary
subcommands.description: Returns compliance details for the conformance pack based on the cumulative compliance results of all the rules in that conformance pack.

subcommands.name: get-connector
subcommands.description: Returns the details of the specified connector.

subcommands.name: get-custom-rule-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the policy definition containing the logic for your Config Custom Policy rule.

subcommands.name: get-discovered-resource-counts
subcommands.description: Returns the resource types, the number of each resource type, and the total number of resources that Config is recording in this region for your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: get-organization-config-rule-detailed-status
subcommands.description: Returns detailed status for each member account within an organization for a given organization Config rule.

subcommands.name: get-organization-conformance-pack-detailed-status
subcommands.description: Returns detailed status for each member account within an organization for a given organization conformance pack.

subcommands.name: get-organization-custom-rule-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the policy definition containing the logic for your organization Config Custom Policy rule.

subcommands.name: get-resource-config-history
subcommands.description: For accurate reporting on the compliance status, you must record the AWS::Config::ResourceCompliance resource type.

subcommands.name: get-resource-evaluation-summary
subcommands.description: Returns a summary of resource evaluation for the specified resource evaluation ID from the proactive rules that were run.

subcommands.name: get-status
subcommands.description: Reports the status of all of configuration recorders and delivery channels.

subcommands.name: get-stored-query
subcommands.description: Returns the details of a specific stored query.

subcommands.name: list-aggregate-discovered-resources
subcommands.description: Accepts a resource type and returns a list of resource identifiers that are aggregated for a specific resource type across accounts and regions.

subcommands.name: list-configuration-recorders
subcommands.description: Returns a list of configuration recorders depending on the filters you specify.

subcommands.name: list-conformance-pack-compliance-scores
subcommands.description: Returns a list of conformance pack compliance scores.

subcommands.name: list-connectors
subcommands.description: Returns a list of connectors depending on the filters you specify.

subcommands.name: list-discovered-resources
subcommands.description: Returns a list of resource resource identifiers for the specified resource types for the resources of that type.

subcommands.name: list-resource-evaluations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of proactive resource evaluations.

subcommands.name: list-stored-queries
subcommands.description: Lists the stored queries for a single Amazon Web Services account and a single Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: List the tags for Config resource.

subcommands.name: put-aggregation-authorization
subcommands.description: Authorizes the aggregator account and region to collect data from the source account and region.

subcommands.name: put-config-rule
subcommands.description: Adds or updates an Config rule to evaluate if your Amazon Web Services resources comply with your desired configurations.

subcommands.name: put-configuration-aggregator
subcommands.description: Creates and updates the configuration aggregator with the selected source accounts and regions.

subcommands.name: put-configuration-recorder
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the customer managed configuration recorder.

subcommands.name: put-conformance-pack
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a conformance pack.

subcommands.name: put-connector
subcommands.description: Creates a connector that specifies the connection between a third-party cloud service provider and Config.

subcommands.name: put-delivery-channel
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a delivery channel to deliver configuration information and other compliance information.

subcommands.name: put-evaluations
subcommands.description: Used by an Lambda function to deliver evaluation results to Config.

subcommands.name: put-external-evaluation
subcommands.description: Add or updates the evaluations for process checks.

subcommands.name: put-organization-config-rule
subcommands.description: Adds or updates an Config rule for your entire organization to evaluate if your Amazon Web Services resources comply with your desired configurations.

subcommands.name: put-organization-conformance-pack
subcommands.description: Deploys conformance packs across member accounts in an Amazon Web Services Organization.

subcommands.name: put-remediation-configurations
subcommands.description: Adds or updates the remediation configuration with a specific Config rule with the selected target or action.

subcommands.name: put-remediation-exceptions
subcommands.description: A remediation exception is when a specified resource is no longer considered for auto-remediation.

subcommands.name: put-resource-config
subcommands.description: Records the configuration state for the resource provided in the request.

subcommands.name: put-retention-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates and updates the retention configuration with details about retention period (number of days) that Config stores your historical information.

subcommands.name: put-service-linked-configuration-recorder
subcommands.description: Creates a service-linked configuration recorder that is linked to a specific Amazon Web Services service based on the ServicePrincipal you specify.

subcommands.name: put-stored-query
subcommands.description: Saves a new query or updates an existing saved query.

subcommands.name: put-third-party-service-linked-configuration-recorder
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a service-linked configuration recorder that is linked to a third-party cloud service provider based on the ConnectorArn you specify.

subcommands.name: select-aggregate-resource-config
subcommands.description: Accepts a structured query language (SQL) SELECT command and an aggregator to query configuration state of Amazon Web Services resources across multiple accounts and regions, performs the corresponding search, and returns resource configurations matching the properties.

subcommands.name: select-resource-config
subcommands.description: Accepts a structured query language (SQL) SELECT command, performs the corresponding search, and returns resource configurations matching the properties.

subcommands.name: start-config-rules-evaluation
subcommands.description: Runs an on-demand evaluation for the specified Config rules against the last known configuration state of the resources.

subcommands.name: start-configuration-recorder
subcommands.description: Starts the customer managed configuration recorder.

subcommands.name: start-remediation-execution
subcommands.description: Runs an on-demand remediation for the specified Config rules against the last known remediation configuration.

subcommands.name: start-resource-evaluation
subcommands.description: Runs an on-demand evaluation for the specified resource to determine whether the resource details will comply with configured Config rules.

subcommands.name: stop-configuration-recorder
subcommands.description: Stops the customer managed configuration recorder.

subcommands.name: subscribe
subcommands.description: Subscribes user to AWS Config by creating an AWS Config delivery channel and configuration recorder to track AWS resource configurations.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associates the specified tags to a resource with the specified ResourceArn.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Deletes specified tags from a resource.
